title: Identification of new benzimidazole-triazole hybrids as anticancer agents: multi-target recognition, in vitro and in silico studies.
authors: Othman, Dina I A; Hamdi, Abdelrahman; Tawfik, Samar S; Elgazar, Abdullah A; Mostafa, Amany S
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯并咪唑-三唑杂合物的多靶点抗癌活性，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但核心对象为小分子-蛋白/小分子-DNA，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Multi-target inhibitors represent useful anticancer agents with superior therapeutic attributes. Here in, two novel series of benzimidazole-triazole hybrids were designed, synthesised as multi-target EGFR, VEGFR-2 and Topo II inhibitors, and evaluated for anticancer activity. Compounds 5a and 6g were the most potent analogues against four cancer cell lines, HepG-2, HCT-116, MCF-7 and HeLa, and were further evaluated for EGFR, VEGFR-2, and Topo II inhibition. Compound 5a was especially good inhibitor for EGFR (IC(50) = 0.086 microM) compared to Gefitinib (IC(50) = 0.052 microM), moderate VEGFR-2 inhibitor (IC(50) = 0.107 microM) compared to Sorafenib (IC(50) = 0.0482 microM), and stronger Topo II inhibitor (IC(50) = 2.52 microM) than Doxorubicin (IC(50) = 3.62 microM). Compound 6g exhibited moderate EGFR and VEGFR-2 inhibition and weaker Topo II inhibition. DNA binding assay, cell cycle analysis, apoptotic induction, molecular docking, and physicochemical studies were additionally implemented to explore the plausible mechanism of the active compounds.
abstract_zh: 多靶点抑制剂代表了具有优越治疗属性的有用抗癌药物。在此，设计并合成了两个新型系列的苯并咪唑-三唑杂合体，作为多靶点EGFR、VEGFR-2和Topo II抑制剂，并评估了其抗癌活性。化合物5a和6g是对四种癌细胞系HepG-2、HCT-116、MCF-7和HeLa最具效力的类似物，并进一步评估了它们对EGFR、VEGFR-2和Topo II的抑制作用。化合物5a尤其是一种良好的EGFR抑制剂（IC(50) = 0.086微摩尔），与吉非替尼（IC(50) = 0.052微摩尔）相比，是中等强度的VEGFR-2抑制剂（IC(50) = 0.107微摩尔），与索拉非尼（IC(50) = 0.0482微摩尔）相比，并且是比多柔比星（IC(50) = 3.62微摩尔）更强的Topo II抑制剂（IC(50) = 2.52微摩尔）。化合物6g表现出中等的EGFR和VEGFR-2抑制作用以及较弱的Topo II抑制作用。此外，还进行了DNA结合实验、细胞周期分析、凋亡诱导、分子对接和理化性质研究，以探索活性化合物的可能作用机制。
